description_en: Queries the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model information of a specified category
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定品类的物模型信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-thing-template --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --resource-group-id rg-acfm4l5tcwd0000 --category-key Lighting --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetThingTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

><notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The **ResourceGroupId** request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

><notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数**ResourceGroupId**配置已无效，无需再传入。
></notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the category to query.
You can view the CategoryKey of each category from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150316.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的品类的标识符。
可以从调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150316.html的返回数据中，查看各品类的CategoryKey
parameters.name: category_key
